open_points.text: - _project_budget_sections: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] For a plan whose section has no progress row, MUST emit completion_percent None and completed_work_value Decimal zero; completed_work_value is a required Decimal and never None. Every other emitted field is a required Decimal too, so material_actual and material_remaining are Decimal zero when nothing is allocated rather than None.
